---
title: "Carbon Sequestration"
---

This site presents the **carbon sequestration ecosystem service accounts** of the European Union for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018
and 2024. Carbon sequestration is the uptake of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere by ecosystems, which contributes to global
climate regulation. The accounts measure the removals of land, the net flow that reaches society after the emissions of land
use are offset, and the part of the removals that those emissions use up, in physical and monetary terms.

The [report](documentation/methods/carbon-sequestration/index.qmd) describes the methods, the decisions taken along the way
and the results. The [Downloads](downloads/index.qmd) page holds the tables by NUTS region and the 100 m maps. The numbered
scripts in the folder <https://github.com/renatovargas/jrc-carbon-sequestration/tree/main/scripts> reproduce the work, and Annex I of the report explains each of them.
